checks.output: Hero checks passed: defaults and no-image state, safe image sources, placement/overlay bounds, legacy migration, live result preservation, cloning, widget overrides, draft/publication isolation, storage failure and aggregate size limits.

Lobby checks passed: isolated drafts, immutable publication, widget order, stable room targeting, validation, safe internal links, persistence/reload, failed storage, cross-tab refresh and corrupt storage fallback.

Legacy tournament checks passed: seeded/random/manual brackets, 7-player byes, 32-player progression/champion, score validity, walkovers, safe result corrections, eligibility/windows, immutable started settings, duplicates, audit, durable restore, inherited admin settings and automatic check-in window.
Double-elimination and board checks passed: 126 exhaustive small-field outcomes, 4/8/16/64 fields and byes, both GF paths/reset, graph corrections, player exclusivity, rest/readiness/check-in gates, manual/automatic boards, participant-only access and legacy migration.
Tournament room store checks passed: self readiness, viewer denial, start/result ownership, active-match pause protection, board release and DE persistence.
Cross-tournament start exclusivity passed.

Chat tab checks passed: legacy migration, adjacent fallback, private-only lobby, retained messages/drafts, closed-tab persistence, explicit reopening, and incoming messages without tab resurrection.
Chat UX checks passed: replaceable two-second room notices outside history, spectator seeds, and spectator messages in the match channel.

Game checks passed: impact-only scoring/history, 180, per-visit grouping, exact restore, duplicate/stale landing protection, bust explanations, checkout, alternating starters and forfeit.
Turn clock checks passed: two warnings before a loss, accepted stop resets warnings, opponent and finished match guards, legacy restore.

Demo OTP checks passed: input/paste, email normalization, expiry, attempts, resend invalidation/cooldown/limit, reserved and unique usernames, returning profile, no raw email/code persistence, player-only session, and safe destination.
